Project Description: VR-125883 
DXC-Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft. DXC-Luxoft is currently supporting several German OEMs in building their next-generation battery-electric vehicle platforms. We help industrializing, integrating and testing the platform and functional software, especially during critical integration phases approaching start-of-production. For expanding our business offering in the European market, we seek to establish experienced automotive engineers. DXC-Luxoft is happy to receive applications from self-motivated and self-disciplined applicants who communicate well, like to work in teams, and are highly motivated to bring value to our automotive customers. For the successful candidate we offer the opportunity to enhance and develop your career with the following benefits: Join a highly competent and motivated international team Apply your talent into creating the mobility solutions of the future Gain hands-on experience working with well-recognized customers Personal growth and promotion options Make an impact on the overall growth of DXC-Luxoft Our interesting project connected with cutting edge automotive technologies.
 Responsibilities: 
▸ Testing & Analysis
Execute complex end-to-end and exploratory test scenarios on integrated system targets.
Perform intermediate log and network trace analysis to identify signal mismatches, protocol errors, and integration defects.
Conduct black-box system testing across hardware and software components, ensuring integration-level coverage.
Identify gaps between test specifications and actual system behavior; proactively flag inconsistencies.
Own test report quality: ensure every defect is backed by clear, reproducible evidence.
▸ Defect Lifecycle & Coordination
Own defects end-to-end: from initial analysis and evidence collection through to developer confirmation and closure.
Organize and lead alignment meetings with developers and stakeholders to confirm defect validity and track resolution progress.
Defend defect claims technically: present reproduction steps and log data to achieve developer buy-in.
Coordinate across teams to determine fix timelines and prevent ticket back-and-forth.
▸ Process & Collaboration
Apply structured testing frameworks (ASPICE or equivalent) consistently across all test activities.
Operate effectively within an Agile/SAFe environment, interfacing with Functional Owners and Product Owners.
Differentiate between documented observations and hypothetical scenarios at all times.
Support junior colleagues with guidance on defect documentation and test execution practices.
 Mandatory Skills Description: 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of hands-on experience in system, integration, or end-to-end testing of complex software and hardware systems.
Proven expertise in log and network trace analysis (Ethernet, CAN, SOME/IP, DoIP, or comparable communication protocols) to identify and drive resolution of complex issues.
Extensive experience managing defects throughout the complete JIRA lifecycle, including root cause analysis, stakeholder alignment, and closure verification.
Strong knowledge of structured testing and quality processes, including ASPICE, ISO 29119, or equivalent industry standards.
Experience defining test strategies, reviewing test specifications, and identifying gaps in test coverage.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to independently investigate complex integration issues.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to effectively present technical findings to developers, customers, and management stakeholders.
Experience working in Agile/SAFe development environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
Ability to mentor junior engineers and drive best practices in testing, defect management, and quality assurance.
 Nice-to-Have Skills Description: 
Extensive experience with automotive and embedded communication protocols, including CAN, SOME/IP, Ethernet, DoIP, and related vehicle networks.
ISTQB Advanced Level Test Analyst certification (or equivalent) is highly desirable.
Strong experience working in SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) environments and collaborating across multiple Agile teams and stakeholders.
Proficient in professional diagnostic and trace analysis tools such as Wireshark, CANalyzer, CANoe, or equivalent industry-standard solutions.
Solid Python and scripting skills for log analysis, test automation, data processing, and test framework enhancement.
Experience troubleshooting complex integration issues using protocol traces, diagnostic data, and system logs.
Ability to define and improve test methodologies, tools, and processes to increase test efficiency and product quality.
Experience mentoring junior engineers in test execution, debugging techniques, and automotive communication analysis.
 Languages: 
English: B2 Upper Intermediate
